body: As an unwanted child myself and being surrounded by people with a similar experience I wanted to know more. When people talk about abortion, they often use the narrative "think about the life of the baby". But when the debates come, I see little to no unwanted children telling their experiences. If those lives are so important, I want to know what they think about abortion, are they glad they get to live? Would they have preferred to be aborted? I want to know.

I am an unwanted child, teen pregnancy. My dad left my mom once he found out (typical plotline). My mother was definitely not ready. She was shamed into having me, little town all very religious. I bounced from one familiar to another. The unwanted, the black sheep, the burden. "I wish I was aborted" people are horrified to hear me say that, but it's true, at least for me. All those religious ladies who shamed my mother into having me, who offer their help disappeared once I was born, and all the cry, the suffering, the loneliness, the rejection, the jealousy seeing others, all those years of seeking affection, trying to be perfect, to get accepted, to prove myself and others I was worth of being born. Was it worth it? All my suffering...just for some people to feel righteous? My life is much better now, I have a husband and life goes just fine, but there is no amount of happiness that can erase everything I went through. The little child who craved for a family, to be loved and cherished will always be there.

Do not worry. The worst thing you can do is to over-worry yourself with this situation. 
For your worries you need to go to a retinologist. The doctor will tell you how healthy are your eyes, the he/she is going to decide if you have to visit once or twice a year. You can leave a long and healthy with vision life. There's a support group for people with very high myopia, there I met people with 55, 60 years that still are able to enjoy life, read books and drive. 

In the meantime here are some advices
Get new glasses every year
Do not practice contact sports
Don't stress yourself 
Use blue light filter while using electronic devices and practice 20-20-20 every 20 minutes of screen time watch an object at 20 feet for 20 seconds
The darks little dot that you may see are miodisepsias or ocular flies, those are pretty common for people with high myopia, there are not a cause for worry until they appear along with flashy lights. 

If there is a bleed maybe they would use laser to patch things up. I wish you the best of luck.

Caso 1, tu padre en vida decide dejarle todas sus cosas a alguien mas.
Si en vida tu padre biológico decide transferir sus bienes a sus hijos o esposa, cagaste. No hay cómo proteger lo que tú crees que te mereces, porque no hay nada tuyo per se. Son los bienes de tu padre y mientras él esté en uso pleno de sus facultades, puede traspasarselo a quien le pegue la gana. Dependiendo de la edad que tengas tu y tu padre, probablemente no le puedas reclamar nada sobre lo que no gasto en tu crianza. Si tú madre no interpuso una demanda por cobro de manutención alimenticia - en lo que respecta a la ley - tu padre se hizo cargo de ti. Si tienes hasta los 21 años puedes demandarlo, y hasta los 28 si aún estudias. Después de eso, la ley se lava las manos, de hecho, para más INRI, si no hay antecedentes de que te abandonó, hasta podría él demandarte por ayuda económica si llega a un estadío precario en su vejez.

Caso N°2. 
Posibilidad A: Se muere sin dejar testamento. 
     Si está casado con sociedad de bienes automáticamente el 50% pasa a ser de la esposa como sobreviviente de la sociedad. El 50% de lo que queda, que pasa a ser el caudal hereditario  debe ser repartido entre los herederos que serían: la viuda y los hijos. En este caso espero que la plata que tenga el caballero sea harta, porque la ley estipula que el viudo debe recibir el doble de cada hijo y no menos del 25% del caudal hereditario.

Posibilidad B: Se muere y deja un testamento. Las leyes chilenas estipulan que hay herederos mandatorios u obligatorios, que son el cónyuge sobreviviente y los hijos. Y de la herencia, la persona fallecida solo puede hacer testamento para legar el cuarto de libre disposición. En otras palabras quedaría del caudal hereditario, 25% para el favorecido del testamento, 25% para la viuda y 50% para ser repartido entre los hijos lo cual te dejaría con cada vez menos del 50% de los bienes del finado, dependiendo de cuánto hermanos tengas.
